measurement.method: probes every 60 seconds from at least 3 locations; a minute is down if at least 2 locations fail; availability = (total minutes - excluded minutes - Downtime minutes) / (total minutes - excluded minutes) x 100, rounded to 2 decimals; Downtime = at least 5 consecutive minutes

credit_tier_1.condition: availability below 99.9% but at or above 99.0%

A.claim_deadline: 30 days after the end of the measurement period
A.credit_payment: deducted from next invoice; if no further invoice, paid by bank transfer within 30 days of confirmation

other_numbers.chronic_failure: below tier 2 threshold in 3 periods within rolling 12 months allows termination on 30 days' notice
